proposed_widenings.name: FeatRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts has no 'feat' kind. SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord is the exhaustive union; feat_root exists in the v4 taxonomy atom inventory but has never been given a corresponding surface record type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting Feature)

proposed_widenings.name: passive_spell_cast_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Free Casting fires passively on every spell cast with a L1-4 slot — not an activation. The existing activation family requires an explicit activation cost. A passive trigger on spell_cast_window needs a new feat/feature family (analogous to on_hit_trigger for masteries but keyed to spell-casting events).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4.

proposed_widenings.name: probabilistic_roll_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The check is: roll 1d4, compare result to slot level (a runtime parameter). No surface type models a probabilistic check against a dynamic integer parameter. This is structurally distinct from save_gate (ability check, fixed DC) and attack_roll (vs AC). It needs a new resolution shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

proposed_widenings.name: refund_spell_slot
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect on a successful check is that the spell slot is not expended — a conditional resource refund. The v4 taxonomy lists 'refund' as a procedure atom, but types.ts has no surface variant for it. The closest effect in ClassFeatureEffect is grant_extra_action or heal_hp; neither represents a slot refund.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no FeatRecord kind in UnitRecord. Secondary blockers apply even after that gap is closed: (1) Free Casting is a passive on-cast trigger, not an activation; (2) the roll-against-slot-level check has no surface type; (3) conditional slot refund has no effect atom in the surface. The Ability Score Increase sub-feature is character-progression metadata and would also need handling but is a known deferred concern (modify_ability_score is out-of-scope per TAXONOMY §12). No dhall/json content file produced — no honest encoding is possible.
